scope: Synthetic sensitivity and adapter contract. Real AMD/perf/KVM count, overflow, correction and snapshot completeness acceptance remain separate gates.
historical_evidence: Original source.tar.gz, final-synthetic/, manifest.json and integration-contract.json are unchanged; source.tar.gz is authoritative for API v1.

new_observation_fields.identity: BoundaryIdentity { kind: BoundaryKind, cpu: CpuId, landing: LandingIdentity { count: BranchCount, rip: u64, registers: Fields } }
new_observation_fields.cpu_inventory: Vec<CpuId { machine: u64, incarnation: u64, vcpu: u32 }> enumerates ALL live machine CPUs; sorted inventory is part of canonical CPU state
new_observation_fields.branch_count: BranchCount { source, profile_id, value: Option<u64>, validity: Valid|Unavailable|Invalid{reason}, overflow: None|Accounted{wraps}|Unaccounted, epoch: u64 }
new_observation_fields.profile_counter: CounterProfile { source, profile_id, width_bits: Option<u8>, configuration: Fields, validation: SyntheticOnly|UnvalidatedHardware|Validated{evidence_sha256,scope} }

count_definition: Pin the exact event/CPU/microcode/KVM/perf/filter profile and counting semantics, including conditional vs all branches, privilege filters, whether correction execution contributes, raw-counter normalization, width/wrap accounting and counter reset epochs. epoch is scoped by CpuId and represents an explicit reset; include pending budgets/targets and counter control state in backend/world state. Source/profile validity is a declaration, not evidence manufactured by the witness.
landing_state: Mandatory x86 RCX/RSI/RDI/RFLAGS plus RIP must agree with captured CPU fields. Add architecturally relevant registers and interrupt/debug transition fields (e.g. interrupt shadow, pending injected events, debug registers, CR2/exception state) or list omitted fields as unavailable. Synthetic fixture includes interrupt_shadow/pending_exception/dr6/cr2; real KVM getter/validity integration is not implemented.
comparison: Boundary kind, source/profile/count/value/validity/overflow/epoch, active CPU identity, RIP and landing-register differences are first-class categories before general CPU/page/world differences. Application-output equality does not suppress any mismatch. Identity bytes are retained even in compact traces.
validation_rules: Landing count source/profile must match pinned CounterProfile.
A Valid count requires a value and cannot have Unaccounted overflow; PrecisePreemption requires Valid.
CPU inventory cannot contain duplicate identities or omit the landing CPU.
Every inventory CPU must contain named RIP/RFLAGS; broader complete architecture-state enumeration remains the adapter's declared responsibility.
Landing RIP and every provided landing register must agree with captured CPU values; RCX/RSI/RDI/RFLAGS cannot be omitted.
correction_api: Witness::record_correction(CorrectionObservation { cpu, phase, landing }) stores trace.corrections outside canonical hashes, comparison and committed boundary index. Use only intermediate debugger/signal-return observations. Natural PIO/MMIO/device/other semantic exits remain committed NaturalVmExit boundaries, even during correction.
world_charge_rules: Observation machinery never advances world time, registers world events, polls scenario actions or selects another CPU. Correction exits add no charges. Count correction guest execution into the final declared count, retain all cumulative RAM changes, and charge the actual committed guest interval once according to the selected policy. No dirty-log reset between correction steps and final capture. Synthetic diagnostic exclusion does not prove real correction transparency.
global_state_scope: Capture every machine CPU plus all serializable world/device/control-protocol state at each completed boundary: explicit commands, request/response payloads and owners, control sequence IDs, pending target/budget/epoch, backend continuation, time/ties, faults, seed streams, caches/durable data and pending events/completions. An inactive CPU snapshot can be reused only when its unchanged state is guaranteed. The witness cannot detect a producer that consistently omits undeclared state.
w1_bridge: world_fields = json_fields("world", &world.snapshot()); extend with explicit control/backend/scenario data where outside that snapshot. W1 opaque future/closure removal is expected; no general Rust Future serialization is required or claimed.
completed_boundary: Complete pending KVM I/O before capture, then capture stopped guest/global state before applying world mutations, IRQ injection, time advancement or CPU selection. Preserve v1 dirty-log plus host-DMA/world-written-page union and full-checkpoint audits.
snapshot_separation: Landing identity equality and declared state equality are different findings. Equal chains do not prove a complete snapshot or restore. Pin boot-once images as explicit inputs only under the coordinator's snapshot policy; actual VM restore remains sequenced after W2/witness integration.
synthetic_fixture: Two machine CPU inventories, three 64-byte pages, seed42, 12 committed boundaries, checkpoints every3. Wrong-count/RIP/RCX/RSI/RDI/kind/inactive-CPU/control-protocol controls first differ at boundary5 with identical application output. Diagnostic-noise control emits 36 correction observations with unchanged chain/world state.
hardware_runs: None by W3. W5a hardware gate retains workstation priority.
